candidates.original_title: A TOMM40 variable-length polymorphism predicts the age of late-onset Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: The polyT repeat (rs10524523) in TOMM40 is associated with age at onset of late-onset Alzheimer's disease
candidates.citation_sentence: Roses et al. used DNA sequencing and an evolutionary network approach to demonstrate that a polyT polymorphism in intron 6 of TOMM40 (rs10524523) is associated with age at onset (AAO) in APOE 33 and 34 individuals.

candidates.original_title: A TOMM40 variable-length polymorphism predicts the age of late-onset Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: The APOE ε3–TOMM40 polyT polymorphism haplotype groups are associated with age at onset of late-onset Alzheimer's disease.
candidates.citation_sentence: In this study we attempted to replicate the recent report by Roses et al.12 that reported an association of APOE 3-TOMM40 polyT polymorphism (rs10524523) haplotypes are associated with age at onset and risk of AD.
candidates.notes: The paper reports no significant association with age at onset after accounting for APOE genotype and concludes that it failed to support the original finding. The original reference does not provide a DOI. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: A TOMM40 variable-length polymorphism predicts the age of late-onset Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: The very-long allele of the APOE ε3–TOMM40 polyT polymorphism is associated with increased risk of late-onset Alzheimer's disease.
candidates.citation_sentence: In this study we attempted to replicate the recent report by Roses et al.12 that reported an association of APOE 3-TOMM40 polyT polymorphism (rs10524523) haplotypes are associated with age at onset and risk of AD.
candidates.notes: The replication found a statistically significant association in the opposite direction from the original report: the very-long allele was less frequent in cases and associated with a protective effect. The authors explicitly describe the result as opposite to the original finding. The original reference does not provide a DOI. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
